svg.title: Which detection service?
svg.desc: A ladder of six questions. Is it suspicious activity in logs or network traffic? Yes: Amazon GuardDuty. Is it a known vulnerability in software? Yes: Amazon Inspector. Is it sensitive data inside S3 objects? Yes: Amazon Macie. Is it a resource setting or its history? Yes: AWS Config. Must findings from many services appear together? Yes: AWS Security Hub. Must you find the root cause of one finding? Yes: Amazon Detective. Each no leads to the next question.
